755-a-lady-s-life-in-the-rocky-mountains.creator: Unknown

LETTER VII Personality of Long's Peak--"Mountain Jim"--Lake of the Lilies--A silent forest--The camping ground--"Ring"--A lady's bower--Dawn and sunrise--A glorious view--Links of diamonds--The ascent of the Peak--The "Dog's Lift"--Suffering from thirst--The descent--The bivouac. 9948-the-banner-boy-scouts-afloat-or-the.title: The Banner Boy Scouts Afloat Or The Secret Of Cedar Island
9948-the-banner-boy-scouts-afloat-or-the.creator: George A. Warren
9948-the-banner-boy-scouts-afloat-or-the.description: A book by George A. Warren. Those of you who are old friends will recollect that while the Red Fox Patrol was forming, the boys had a most strenuous time, what with a deep mystery in their midst, and the bitter strife resulting from their competition with rival troops belonging to neighboring towns. How the beautiful banner was cleverly won by Stanhope, I related in the first volume, called: "The Banner Boy Scouts."

arxiv-1911-00832.title: A Catalog of Periodic Variables in Open Clusters M35 & NGC 2158 Facilities: Kepler (K2), Gaia, MAST, ADS, Exoplanet Archive Astrobase ( Bhatti et al. 2018 ) , Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , BATMAN ( Kreidberg 2015 ) , FITSH ( Pál 2012 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , Numpy ( van der
arxiv-1911-00832.creator: M. Soares-Furtado, J. D. Hartman, W. Bhatti, L. G. Bouma, T. Barna, G. Á. Bakos
arxiv-1911-00832.description: Abstract We present a catalog of 1,143 periodic variables, compiled from our image-subtracted photometric analysis of the K2 Campaign-0 super stamp. This super stamp is centered on the open clusters M35 and NGC 2158. Approximately 46% of our periodic variables were previously unreported.

arxiv-2104-06477.title: Phase separation kinetics of segregating fluid mixtures in the presence of quenched disorder
arxiv-2104-06477.creator: Rounak Bhattacharyya and Bhaskar Sen Gupta
arxiv-2104-06477.description: Abstract Quenched or frozen-in structural disorder is ubiquitous in real experimental systems. Much of the progress is achieved in understanding the phase separation of such systems using the diffusion-driven coarsening in Ising model with quenched disorder. But there is a paucity of research in the phase-separation kinetics in fluids with quenched disorder.

arxiv-2202-01598.title: Probing the SO 2 adsorption mechanism in Hofmann clathrates via inelastic neutron scattering and density functional theory calculations
arxiv-2202-01598.creator: Ángel Fernández-Blanco, Lucía Piñeiro-López, Mónica Jiménez-Ruiz, Stephane Rols, José Antonio Real, J. Alberto Rodríguez-Velamazán, Roberta Poloni
arxiv-2202-01598.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ángel Fernández-Blanco, Lucía Piñeiro-López, Mónica Jiménez-Ruiz, Stephane Rols, José Antonio Real, J. Alberto Rodríguez-Velamazán, Roberta Poloni. The adsorption mechanism of SO 2 in the Hofmann-like coordination polymer Fe(pz)[Pt(CN) 4 ] is studied using inelastic neutron scattering and density functional theory calculations. We find that the most important spectral change upon gas adsorption is the blueshift of the low energy peak found at 100 cm -1 , a feature that is fully confirmed by the computed neutron-weighted phonon density of states.

arxiv-2202-09169.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Vivek Kumar Singh, Nafaa Chbili. Obtaining a closed form expression for the colored HOMFLY-PT polynomials of knots from 3 3 -strand braids carrying arbitrary S ​ U ​ ( N ) SU(N) representation is a challenging problem. arxiv-2210-02396.title: Temporally Consistent Transformers for Video Generation
arxiv-2210-02396.creator: Wilson Yan, Danijar Hafner, Stephen James, Pieter Abbeel
arxiv-2210-02396.description: Abstract To generate accurate videos, algorithms have to understand the spatial and temporal dependencies in the world. Current algorithms enable accurate predictions over short horizons but tend to suffer from temporal inconsistencies. When generated content goes out of view and is later revisited, the model invents different content instead.

arxiv-2303-01877.title: Quantum Merlin-Arthur proof systems for synthesizing quantum states
arxiv-2303-01877.creator: Hugo Delavenne, François Le Gall, Yupan Liu, Masayuki Miyamoto
arxiv-2303-01877.description: Abstract Complexity theory typically focuses on the difficulty of solving computational problems with classical inputs and outputs, even with a quantum computer. In the quantum world, it is natural to apply a different notion of complexity, namely the complexity of synthesizing quantum states.

arxiv-2303-09235.title: Is the Earth’s magnetic field a constant ? a legacy of Poisson
arxiv-2303-09235.creator: J-L. Le Mouël, F. Lopes, V. Courtillot, D. Giber, J-B. Boulé
arxiv-2303-09235.description: Abstract In the report he submitted to the Académie des Sciences, Poisson imagined a set of concentric spheres at the origin of the Earth’s magnetic field. It may come as a surprise to many that Poisson as well as Gauss both considered the magnetic field to be constant.

arxiv-2305-08641.title: Quantum state preparation via engineered ancilla resetting
arxiv-2305-08641.creator: Daniel Alcalde Puente, Felix Motzoi, Tommaso Calarco, Giovanna Morigi, Matteo Rizzi
arxiv-2305-08641.description: Abstract In this theoretical investigation, we examine the effectiveness of a protocol incorporating periodic quantum resetting for preparing ground states of frustration-free parent Hamiltonians. This protocol uses a steering Hamiltonian that enables local coupling between the system and ancillary degrees of freedom. At periodic intervals, the ancillary system is reset to its initial state.

arxiv-2412-11903.title: On the Protection Against Noise for Measurement-Based Quantum Computation
arxiv-2412-11903.creator: Valentin Vankov Iliev
arxiv-2412-11903.description: Abstract Here we establish conditions for some pairs of quantum logic gates which operate on one qubit to be protected against crosstalk. ”In principio erat verbum,…” Ioann 1:1 ”It is operationally impossible to separate reality and information.” Anton Zeilinger 1 Introduction, Notation 1.

arxiv-2503-17803.title: A Roadmap Towards Improving Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Causal Discovery and Inference
arxiv-2503-17803.creator: Giovanni Briglia, Stefano Mariani, Franco Zambonelli
arxiv-2503-17803.description: Abstract Causal reasoning is increasingly used in Reinforcement Learning (RL) to improve the learning process in several dimensions: efficacy of learned policies, efficiency of convergence, generalisation capabilities, safety and interpretability of behaviour. However, applications of causal reasoning to Multi -Agent RL (MARL) are still mostly unexplored.

arxiv-2602-20674.title: Task Concurrency and Compatibility in Measurement-Based Quantum Networks This work was supported, in part, by the Danish National Research Foundation (DNRF), through the Center CLASSIQUE, grant nr. 187.
arxiv-2602-20674.creator: Jakob Kaltoft Søndergaard, René Bødker Christensen, Petar Popovski
arxiv-2602-20674.description: Abstract Measurement-Based Quantum Networks (MBQNs) rely on multipartite pre-shared entanglement resources to satisfy entanglement requests. Traditional designs optimize these resources for individual tasks, neglecting that multiple tasks may arrive concurrently and compete for the same entanglement. We introduce compatibility as a design-level metric, capturing whether concurrent tasks can be satisfied by the same entanglement resources.

britannica-1911-greenwich.title: Greenwich (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-greenwich.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-greenwich.description: Article 'Greenwich' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 12), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The most noteworthy buildings are the hospital and the observatory. Greenwich Hospital, as it is still called, became in 1873 a Royal Naval College. Upon it or its site centre nearly all the historical associations of the place. The noble buildings, contrasting strangely with the wharves adjacent and opposite to it, make a striking picture, standing on the low river-bank with a background formed by the wooded elevation of Greenwich Park.

pmc-10554234.title: FRI172 Assessment Of Plasma Dexamethasone Levels After 1-mg Dexamethasone Suppression Test In Adults With Obesity
pmc-10554234.creator: Pimonrat Paopongpaiboon, Prangareeya Santisitthanon, Natnicha Houngngam, Thiti Snabboon, Patchaya Boonchaya-anant
pmc-10554234.description: Disclosure: P. Paopongpaiboon: None. P. Santisitthanon: None. N. Houngngam: None. T. Snabboon: None. P. Boonchaya-anant: None. Background: The 1-mg overnight dexamethasone suppression test is the most frequently used screening test for Cushing’s syndrome. It has been proposed that obese patients may have insufficient plasma dexamethasone levels for the test which may result in false positives.

pmc-11658102.title: Searching for private patient information in Internet resources (patient-targeted Google)—experiences of nurses and nursing students
pmc-11658102.creator: Patrycja Zurzycka, Katarzyna Wojtas, Zofia Musiał, Grażyna Puto, Katarzyna Czyżowicz, Iwona Repka
pmc-11658102.description: BackgroundThe Internet is a source of many information about users who are unaware of the extent to which their privacy and anonymity are abolished. The purpose of this study was to evaluate the prevalence of patient-targeted Google and to know about selected factors influencing such searches among nurses and midwives, as well as nursing and midwifery students.

pmc-12549515.title: Aplastic anemia following high-voltage electrical injury: A case report
pmc-12549515.creator: Mehdi Ayaz, Dorsa Ayaz, Asma Keshavarz
pmc-12549515.description: IntroductionHigh-voltage electrical injuries (HVEI) can lead to a wide range of complications, including musculoskeletal, neurological, cardiac, and renal damage. Hematological complications are rare but have been reported, with aplastic anemia being an exceptionally uncommon consequence. To date, only two cases of aplastic anemia following HVEI have been documented.

pmc-12584053.title: Complementary Strategies for Temporal Lifting Techniques: Biomechanical Insights From Combined Injection Techniques
pmc-12584053.creator: Wencheng Fan, Yanping Gao, Xiaohui Qin, Lin Chen, Li Zou, Chuanxiu Zeng, Linghuan Zeng
pmc-12584053.description: BackgroundAlthough the use of hyaluronic acid–based soft tissue fillers in the lateral facial region is known to have full‐face aesthetic effects, systematic comparisons of injection techniques remain limited.AimsTo compare the full‐face effects of posterotemporal lifting alone and combined with supraperiosteal zygomatic arch injection, and to evaluate the use of images from three device types for aesthetic assessment.

pmc-12607211.title: The epidemiological features of and correlation between central obesity and major cardiometabolic disease clustering among middle-aged and elderly residents in Xinjiang
pmc-12607211.creator: Maidina Abudusilimu, Xiamusiye Muyiduli, Shawulaxi Rejiafu, Adila Sulidan, Chunmei Ling, Rong Zhang
pmc-12607211.description: BackgroundResearch analysing central obesity and cardiometabolic diseases among residents in multiethnic areas in western China is relatively rare. The purpose of this study was to explore the epidemiological features of and correlations between central obesity and cardiometabolic disease clustering in residents of Xinjiang aged 40 years and older.

pmc-12680548.title: Polylactic‐ Glycolic Acid Microparticles–Encapsulated Prostaglandin E1 as A Novel Strategy In Triple Negative Breast Cancer
pmc-12680548.creator: Concetta Di Natale, Elena Lagreca, Raffaele Crispino, Roberta D’Auria, Alessandro Attanasio, Rezvan Jamaledin, Raffaele Vecchione, Paolo Antonio Netti
pmc-12680548.description: Triple‐negative breast cancer (TNBC) is characterized by unique clinical and pathological traits, from which its aggressive nature and the absence of specific treatments are the most worrying. Prostaglandin E1 (PGE1) can affect the morphology of human breast tumor cell lines, but its potential therapeutic effects appear to be counteracted by its high degradability in physiological environments.

pmc-13137704.title: Epigenetic activation of VEGFA by SMARCD1 mediates tumor progression and bevacizumab resistance in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
pmc-13137704.creator: Hanqing Liu, Yan Shen, Yuchen Hou, Congyun Xu, Xiaoyu Bai, Yixun Liu, Jun Xiao
pmc-13137704.description: BackgroundClear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) is an aggressive malignancy characterized by strong invasiveness and treatment resistance. Although SMARCD1 has been studied in several cancers, its function in ccRCC and its regulatory relationship with the key angiogenic factor VEGFA remain unexplored.MethodsClinical relevance of SMARCD1 was assessed through in vitro experiments and data analysis.

pmc-13319269.title: The role of amygdala GABA neurons in controlling stress and reproduction in female mice
pmc-13319269.creator: Junru Yu, Saeed Farjami, Kateryna Nechyporenko, Xiao Feng Li, Hafsa Yaseen, Yanyan Lin, Jinbin Ye, Owen Hollings, Ross de Burgh, Baban Singh, Kevin T O’Byrne, Krasimira Tsaneva-Atanasova, Margaritis Voliotis
pmc-13319269.description: Stress can disrupt menstrual cycles, impair fertility and cause reproductive disfunction. The posterodorsal medial amygdala (MePD) integrates stress signals and regulates the gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) pulse generator through a dense network of GABA and Urocortin-3 (UCN3) neurons, yet the mechanisms underlying the circuitry remain poorly understood.

uslaw-usc-t10-s8737.title: 10 U.S.C. § 8737 — Violations by lessee
uslaw-usc-t10-s8737.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s8737.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part IV (General Administration); Chapter 869 (Naval Petroleum Reserves). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) If a lessee fails to comply with any provision of this chapter, of his lease, or of regulations issued under section 8736 of this title that are in force on the date of his lease, the lease may be forfeited.
